program.name: Shoulder Day
program.subject: Shoulders
program.blurb: Two shoulder days for every other day: presses, then raises and shrugs, then legs and back.
program.about: Two days of shoulders for every day of everything else. The first is presses, from dumbbells and the kettlebell to pike push-ups, with a triceps move to finish. The second is raises for the side and rear heads, with shrugs for the traps. The third day trains legs and back. Abs finish every session; Level II asks for heavier weights and Level III adds reps.
